top_apps.name: Nut Rush: Screw Sort Puzzle
top_apps.description_short: Unscrew, sort the colorful nuts & bolts, and clear every screw. Relax & enjoy!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Nut Rush is a relaxing sorting puzzle about unscrewing bolts and organizing colored nuts. It is easy to understand, calm to play, and built around one simple idea: bring order to a colorful mess, one move at a time.

WHAT THE GAME IS
Every level shows a small set of bolts, and each bolt is stacked with nuts of different colors all jumbled together. Your job is to move the nuts around so that, by the end, every bolt holds nuts of just one color. Once all the colors are sorted into neat single-color stacks, the level is complete and you move on to the next one.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap a bolt to pick up the nut on top of it.
2. Tap another bolt to place that nut down.
3. A nut can only be placed on a bolt whose top nut is the same color, or on an empty bolt.
4. Keep unscrewing and moving nuts until each bolt is a single solid color to clear the board.

The rules take only a few seconds to learn, but solving each board takes a little thought. You will need to plan ahead, keep an empty bolt free as breathing room, and decide the right order to move things so you do not get stuck. Every level has a solution — finding the cleanest path is the fun part.

top_apps.name: Chain Nova
top_apps.description_short: Link the stars, spark a nova.
top_apps.description_excerpt: Chain Nova invites you into a vibrant cosmic puzzle where your mission is to connect adjacent planets within a 3×3 grid. Simply drag your finger across the screen, linking planets that share a border—horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Each successful link earns you points, and the longer the chain, the higher your score multiplier. But think strategically: chaining more planets in a single move triggers a Nova Burst, clearing the grid and rewarding you with bonus points. As you progress, new planet types emerge—some grant extra points, others act as wildcards that link to any neighbor. The challenge intensifies with shifting board layouts and limited moves per level, forcing you to plan each connection carefully. With its intuitive one-finger controls, mesmerizing particle effects, and progressively tricky puzzles, Chain Nova delivers a satisfying and mind-sharpening experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. Can you master the grid and unleash the ultimate cosmic chain?
